Evelyn Park: Kicking off Aurora Care onboarding. Goal: in-app summarization + semantic search for clinician notes. Brief sync at 11am PT.
Omar Rahman: Who's on their side?
Evelyn Park: Contacts: Zoe (product), Ravi (data lead), and Priya (compliance). Zoe is joining here.
Zoe Martinez: hey all 44b. Peak: ~300 concurrent clinicians, hourly batch embeddings, sensitive PHI. Compliance will need our HIPAA checklist.
Ravi Patel: we'll need retention limits and a dataflow diagram. Also prefer dedicated capacity for steady throughput.
Omar Rahman: Suggested success criteria:
- sandbox endpoint fully functional with sample notes
- nightly embeddings pipeline validated
- console admin trained + 2 runbook playbooks delivered
- compliance signoff on dataflow and retention
Evelyn Park: Proposed timeline:
Week 0: security intake + test creds
Week 1: integration spike (realtime + batch)
Week 2: load tests + quant tuning
Week 3: enablement + compliance signoff
Zoe Martinez: blocker: compliance wants a data deletion SLA in the contract. Also, they asked for audit-log retention 12 months.
Evelyn Park: Action items:
- Zoe: send sample notes schema + redaction rules by EOD
- Ravi: prepare dataflow diagram and retention options by Thu
- Omar: provision sandbox + reserved instance estimate by Fri
- Evelyn: open legal ticket for data deletion SLA language
OnboardBot: Onboarding record created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/3115002468 4c4 checklist: sandbox, demo, retention SLA, enablement call
Zoe Martinez: I'll upload the schema and point Ravi to the compliance contacts.
Omar Rahman: Sandbox creds requested; will post link when ready.
Evelyn Park: Renewal note: procurement review in 6 weeks. If compliance signoff delayed >2 weeks, flag as elevated risk. Recommend twice-weekly sync until retention is agreed.
Ravi Patel: noted. Planning a short tech deep-dive after the 11am call.
Evelyn Park: Thanks everyone 44d. I'll share meeting notes and next steps here after the call.
